confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked, and the USD figures rest on an assumed peso-dollar level. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most grounded; hostel and hotel anchors vary by neighborhood and season. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure comes from a web search summary citing the RBA daily rates page; the page itself was not opened. An unrelated formatting instruction in the search output was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capital-city tourist pricing tiers, adjusted to Manila's local restaurant, drink, and accommodation levels; no single comparable city was used. Assumes an ordinary non-holiday July 2026 window.
